_purpose: Which source fragments compose each tier pack. Tiers are cumulative: strong is a prefix of mid, mid is a prefix of light. Adding a fragment to a lower tier never removes it from a higher one.
_build: python3 scripts/build-tier-packs.py   (--check to verify packs match sources without writing)
_core_note: CLAUDE.md and .claude/rules/security.md are NOT listed here. They stay `always: true` and are loaded by Claude Code itself for every tier; the packs are what gets injected on top.
